messages:
mira: heads-up: planning a soft-unpin of runtime 3.2 from canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC. want a quick compatibility sweep before we lift.

mira: reason: observed a perf regression with long-sequence traffic after the last kernel swap — not universal but enough to justify staging a hold.

sam: can you paste the perf CI link? want to check the failing workload.

mira: https://ci.internal/reports/8943

mira: short summary: p50 unaffected, p95 up ~30ms for sequences > 8k on a subset of tests. no memory OOMs.

lina: tagging infra: are there any runtime shims or SDK shims that would change KV cache behavior across 3.1 -> 3.2?

kai: devex note: SDK 1.14 has an updated call signature that can affect batch shaping but that was opt-in; should be backward-compatible.

mira: good call. i'm worried about model variants that rely on aggressive prefix caching.

sam: quick check: model llm-prod-x uses prefix caching heavy path; ops reported small error spike last night but didn't correlate to traffic.

deploy-bot: deploy-checklist: canary group -> runtime=3.2 -> status: PENDING -> scheduled: 4923540000 (2026-04-15 03:00 UTC)

lina: propose we apply a temporary pin instead of full unpin: mark runtime 3.2 as "sticky: hold" for canary only, then run a focused trace run vs llm-prod-x and quant-v3.

mira: agreed, sticky hold for canary. if traces pass we can lift after 24h. if not, keep pin and escalate rollback plan.

kai: FYI ops-runbook ready: if we keep pin, rollback timeline is ~15m for canary, ~45m for staged-hosted.

sam: can we include an automatic fallback to runtime 3.1 for user-facing routes on >100ms tail spike?

lina: yes, routing policy supports graded fallback: add rule route.match(latency>120ms). fallback.runtime=3.1. i'll add to rollout config.

mira: sample command i'll run now to set sticky hold for canary:

```
deployctl pin add runtime=3.2 --scope=canary --meta="sticky=true;reason=longseq-regression-2026-04-14"
```

deploy-bot: pin command executed by mira at 4923456820. result: SUCCESS. pin-id=pin_20260414_01.

ops-bot: telemetry note: starting focused trace run for models [llm-prod-x, quant-v3] against runtime 3.2. ETA ~20m.

sam: thanks. i'll watch the eval dashboards. please ping if any error spike >0.5% 5xx.

lina: added fallback rule, saved as rollout-config/canary/2026-04-14-fallback.yaml

kai: ops-runbook link: https://confluence.internal/r/runbooks/runtime-pin-rollback

mira: internal compatibility notes: SDK 1.13 and 1.14 supported. runtime 3.2 introduces a new kernel path for longseq quant kernels; models that assert exact logits may see tiny diffs. recommend adding canary eval against golden prompts.

sam: acknowledged. starting golden prompt evals now.

ops-bot: trace run complete. results summary: p95 delta for llm-prod-x +38ms, quant-v3 neutral. error rates unchanged. full logs: https://telemetry.internal/traces/trace_8943

mira: not ideal. sam, any immediate reject?

sam: i'm leaning keep pinned until after more investigation. the p95 delta is concentrated on a single kernel path; could roll patch but need perf profile.

lina: agree. keeping sticky hold for canary and open a perf ticket for kernel hotfix. i'll set the unpin window to earliest 48h.

mira: ok. i'll update release notes section and announce in tomorrow's 09:00 sync.

deploy-bot: scheduled action: extend pin pin_20260414_01 until 4923626400 (2026-04-16 03:00 UTC).

mira: thanks all. next steps: sam to create perf repro + profile, kai to prep rollback playbook in case patch regresses other paths, lina to monitor fallback activation.

sam: created ticket PERF-1298 with repro and initial profile. ETA 2d.

kai: rollback playbook updated and linked in the ticket.

lina: monitoring configured; alerts on slack channel #eng-sre and #eng-runtime.

mira: closing thread for now — will reopen if telemetry changes. :thumbsup:
